master_coverage.observed_evidence: The opening wide establishes entry, occupied waiting hall, counter, nurse, patient and safe circulation before close coverage.

character_count_identity.observed_evidence: Exactly two speaking principals remain identifiable throughout.

crowd_continuity.observed_evidence: Background occupancy varies only with framing and shows no conspicuous fusion or impossible crossing.

blocking_and_framing.observed_evidence: Patient remains public-side/screen-left and nurse staff-side/screen-right; the counter and interlocutor foreground preserve orientation.

gaze_and_eyeline.observed_evidence: Both actors use interlocutor/work-surface eyelines; the final patient reaction remains off-camera screen-right.

wardrobe_construction.observed_evidence: Olive patient outerwear and teal nurse clothing remain stable without changing closures or accessories.

prop_identity_ownership.observed_evidence: The card remains a single blue-and-white ordinary plastic prop through the foreshadow and face-down system check.

privacy.observed_evidence: Card faces, workstation content and patient identifiers stay unreadable in every interval.

lighting_continuity.observed_evidence: Daylight direction and warm-neutral interior light remain consistent.

continuity.observed_evidence: Geography, narrative order, identity, attire, room tone and the coverage-result emotional turn remain coherent.
